import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

const isPositive = (value: number): boolean => value > 0;

describe('a quantity', () => {
  it.each([
    ['one', 1, true],
    ['zero', 0, false],
    ['minus one', -1, false],
  ])('is positive for %s: %s', (_, value, expected) => {
    expect(isPositive(value)).toBe(expected);
  });

  it.each([
    {
      name: 'a very long name that makes the table wrap onto several lines',
      value: 100000000000000000,
      expected: true,
    },
    { name: 'zero', value: 0, expected: false },
  ])('is positive for $name', ({ value, expected }) => {
    const actual = isPositive(value);
    expect(actual).toBe(expected);
  });
});
